descriptionChirho: A bowl or basin made of gold or silver, used as a sacred vessel in temple service. All occurrences are found in late texts describing temple furnishings: the gold and silver bowls weighed out by David for Solomon's temple (1 Chr 28:17), the gold bowls brought back from exile by the returning community (Ezra 1:10), and the gold basins donated by the governor for the rebuilt temple (Ezra 8:27). The word appears in both singular and plural construct forms with no semantic distinction between them.
